pages.text: [#](53341a)The Mystic Branch is the witch's focus for traced workings and stolen creature force. Raise it, hold the channel, and sweep your gaze through the old directional signs until the branch knows the shape.[#]()
pages.title: Mystic Branch

pages.text: [#](53341a)Work the night-only rite that turns an Ent Twig and Mystic Unguent into a branch on paired circles, for **3000 altar power**.[#]()
pages.title: Mystic Branch

pages.text: [#](53341a)Hold use to begin tracing. The HUD marks each up, down, left, and right stroke; release when the named sign appears to cast it, spending infused energy. Some signs demand Demon-soul knowledge before they answer.[#]()
pages.title: Current Use

pages.text: [#](53341a)Enhanced signs need Worship power: first strength permits level 2 signs, and stronger Worship permits level 3. Strong signs may also need time to cool.[#]() [#](53341a)The branch now gives clear feedback when a sign answers or fails.[#]()
[#](53341a)It still also belongs to the wider infusion path, where creature powers and stored charges matter.[#]()
